decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 21.3.2007, the demolition of the existing single storey rear extension and the erection of a single storey rear extension extending the full width of the property by 10.43m x 2.70m height with a flat roof x 3.2m depth - 4.2m depth was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The proposed development, with a volume of 103m3, falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed single storey rear extension to the detached house in the Conservation Area house has a volume of which is within 10% of the original volume of the house

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE
The plans as submitted do not accurately represent the house, as they do not show the existing extension. The lawful certificate hereby issued relates to the extensions shown on the approved plans, which necessitate demolition of the existing single storey rear extension to be lawf
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house.
